sources: Harmony archive: Harmony Pro / BT Apple TV 5 (globalDeviceId 499023, codeset da382813fec6b000), Logitech's shipped Bluetooth profile: arrows, Select, Back, Home, Play/Pause, FastForward, Rewind, Stop, volume, power steps and timing
Harmonizer spike on a tvOS 4K: arrows, Select, Back (0x223), Home (0x40), Play/Pause, NextTrack/PreviousTrack, volume
Board test on the user's Apple TV, 2026-11-11: the Control Center sleep sequence
notes: Logitech's profile also has Menu = 0x223, the same key as Back (the old Siri Remote's Menu button). It's left out so the remote's Menu button falls through to Home; Back covers 0x223.
Play and Pause are both 0xCD (Play/Pause) in Logitech's profile. Here there is one PlayPause command, and the remote's Play and Pause buttons fall back to it.
Volume and Mute go to the TV or receiver over HDMI-CEC, so they only work when CEC is on.
No power control (user, 2026-11-11). Apple TV wakes on any key and sleeps on its own timer, and the only sleep path over Bluetooth goes through Control Center's menu, which breaks with tvOS changes.

History: Logitech's off steps (hold Home 2 s, wait 200 ms, Select) don't sleep current tvOS. A board-tested sequence (hold Home 2 s, wait 800 ms, Down, wait 200 ms, Select) worked on 2026-11-11 but depends on Control Center's layout, so it was dropped.
Logitech's six app-launch inputs (Home x3, then arrows) are left out: they depend on the home-screen layout.
verify: FastForward, Rewind and Stop on the board (Logitech has them, the spike didn't run them)
